A fresh, iOS-inspired look, automatic backups when apps update, and more control over how split apps are saved and shared.

## What's new

- **A new design.** Frosted-glass bars that blur the list beneath them, a floating tab bar, grouped lists, large titles that shrink as you scroll, and smooth spring animations throughout.
- **Auto-backup.** Turn it on for an app and every new version is saved when it updates, even while APK Extractor is closed.
- **History keeps every version.** Saved files are grouped by app, with older versions underneath, so you can share or reinstall a previous version at any time. Removing an item can be undone.
- **Share as APK or APKS.** Sharing a split app now asks whether to send one merged APK or the original parts as an `.apks` bundle, also when sharing several apps at once.
- **Show only split or single APKs.** A new filter next to the app count narrows the list to split apps, single-APK apps, or everything.
- **Live progress.** Extracting and sharing show which app is being processed, how much is done and the time left, with each step of a merge.
- **Your own accent colour.** Pick from nine colours or any colour with the new picker.
- **Search and sort side by side** at the bottom of the screen, within easy reach.

## Improvements

- Tabs switch with a tap and a quick crossfade, and each tab remembers where you were. Swiping inside a screen now always does what it says: share an app, or remove a saved file.
- The install sheet opens in one smooth motion with the app's details already filled in.
- Selected apps are unselected once they have been shared.
- Faster scrolling, and less work for the GPU while the glass blurs.

## Download

Get **`apk-extractor-v1.5.0.apk`**. Requires Android 7.0 or newer. It updates v1.0.0 in place, keeping your settings and history. Android may offer to scan the app before installing, because it doesn't come from the Play Store. Tap "Scan app" and it will install normally.

A merged APK is signed with a key made on your device, so uninstall the original app before installing it. Some apps may not open after being merged; save those as APKS instead.
